## POST `/api/types/userQuota/instances`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Create a user quota within either a file system or a tree quota. Either the filesystem or treeQuota that will contain the new user quota must be specified. Exactly one of uid, unixName or winName must be specified.

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `filesystem` | object | The filesystem in which the new user quota will be created. |
| `treeQuota` | object | The treeQuota (instead of filesystem ) in which the new quota will be created. |
| `uid` | integer (unsigned int) | User ID of the user . |
| `unixName` | string | Unix Name of the user . |
| `winName` | string | Windows Name of the user . The format is 'domain\user' for the domain user . |
| `hardLimit` | integer (unsigned int[64(bytes)]) | Hard limit. The default value 0 means no limitations. |
| `softLimit` | integer (unsigned int[64(bytes)]) | Soft limit. The default value 0 means no limitations. |

**Responses:** `201` Created body fields: `@base`, `updated`, `links`, `content`
